# Frontend animation dependencies

The intro page vendors these unmodified browser builds for local/offline operation:

- Three.js 0.185.1 (`three.module.min.js` and its `three.core.min.js` module) — MIT License, copyright three.js authors.
- Anime.js 4.5.0 (`anime.umd.min.js`) — MIT License, copyright Julian Garnier.

Source projects and license texts:

- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime
